channel.title: Daybrief
channel.description: AI first. Everything else that matters, twice a day.

item.title: rddmwmddr/android-ad-cleaner: Turn off ads, trending searches, news recommendations, and marketing push notifications in domestic Android phone systems. No root required, reversible, supports one-click execution by AI agents.
item.description: A tool that turns off ads, trending searches, news recommendations and marketing push notifications on domestic Android phone systems. It needs no root, is reversible, and can be run in one click by AI agents. Why it matters: Lets AI agents run a one-click cleanup of Android ads and notifications, relevant to new GitHub project followers.

item.title: designfuchen/word-atlas: Word Atlas — Illustrated IELTS vocabulary with 7,298 words, UK/US audio and FSRS review. Open-source app + CC…
item.description: An open-source IELTS vocabulary app with illustrated cards for 7,298 words, UK and US audio, and spaced review, plus a CC BY 4.0 dataset.

item.title: andyhuo520/digital-human-koubo: AI digital-human talking-head videos from one photo: Renoise MCP generation + 5 editing styles + 48…
item.description: A GitHub agent skill that turns one photo and one sentence into a finished AI digital-human talking-head video, with 48 packaging components.

item.title: nightly-labs/openbot: A local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates. Run Codex, Claude, and Grok with dedicated…
item.description: A desktop app giving persistent AI agents from Codex, Claude, Grok and others their own workspaces, queues and agent-to-agent messaging; still a development preview.

item.title: AI and oil worries rattle Asian currencies from Taiwan to Philippines
item.description: Asian currencies are being dragged down by concerns about AI overinvestment and expensive oil, though some central banks have helped currencies buck the trend.

item.title: From Wall Street to Silicon Valley, Anthropic IPO poised to have massive 'trickle-down effect'
item.description: Anthropic's IPO filing positions it for what could be the largest initial stock offering in history, as the AI trade shows signs of strain.

item.title: Everyday is zero-day these days
Memory titans test AI demand while bubble fears transfix markets
item.description: Memory chipmakers including SK Hynix, Samsung, Kioxia and CXMT report earnings this week as investors question whether AI spending is outpacing future demand.

item.title: Haze in Singapore: Normal PM2.5 and good to moderate 24-hour PSI readings islandwide
item.description: Singapore's NEA reports normal PM2.5 and good to moderate 24-hour PSI readings islandwide, with the PSI for Oct 27 forecast at 60-90.

item.title: Cross-request KV cache exposure in the GLM-5.3 Workers AI model, and our remediation with SGLang
item.description: A configuration mismatch in GLM 5.3 on Workers AI triggered an SGLang bug that exposed KV cache pages across requests, affecting 155 responses.

item.title: Greptile takes bug detection beyond code review with GPT-6 Astra
item.description: Greptile uses GPT-6 Astra's computer use to run and test apps, simulating users to catch bugs that code reading alone might miss.

item.title: Why Kyoto Prefectural Government Decided 'Not to Rely Only on Copilot' to Improve Office Efficiency for 7,000 Staff
item.description: Kyoto Prefectural Government found that introducing conversational AI government-wide did not fully ease front-line workers' burden, so it is not relying only on Copilot.

item.title: AI Saves 'X Hours a Month': Is That Really True? Where Did the Saved Time Go?
item.description: Even when presenting the splendid result that 'AI implementation reduced thousands of hours per month,' labor costs do not actually go down. Where did the saved time go?

item.title: As AI reshapes entry-level jobs, India's IT industry grapples with developing future talent
item.description: India's biggest IT firms are hiring fewer fresh graduates as AI changes the skills employers seek, and experts warn of a future talent shortage.

item.title: Anthropic Founders Say They Will Keep Claude Free of Advertising
item.description: Anthropic's seven founders said in a letter in its IPO prospectus that they are committed to keeping Claude free of advertising. They argue Claude's only incentive is to give people helpful answers. Why it matters: Bears on how AI assistants earn revenue and what incentives shape their answers.

item.title: US equities end higher as Anthropic's IPO filing buoys AI stocks
item.description: US stocks closed higher on Monday as Anthropic's IPO filing boosted AI-related stocks, with the technology index leading gains.

item.title: Risks & Rewards: How AI Is Redefining the CISO's Role
item.description: Nvidia's Mark Weatherford says CISOs must help business leaders weigh AI's pros and cons and ensure those deploying it own the risks.

item.title: Why Anthropic’s IPO Prospectus Is Missing So Many Key Figures
item.description: Anthropic's S-1 filing omits several financial figures, largely recent-quarter financials and lease agreements tied to its compute investments.

item.title: Injective launches onchain futures market tracking Nvidia GPU rental costs
item.description: Layer-1 blockchain Injective launched a perpetual futures market on the rental prices of five Nvidia GPUs, with up to 10x leverage.

item.title: A security flaw has been discovered in TOTOLINK A950RG 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104
item.description: A security flaw has been discovered in TOTOLINK A950RG 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104. Affected by this issue is the function sub_402340 of the file infostat.cgi of the component Device-Information CGI.

item.title: Former pentester used ARTEX AI to steal 8.2 million data records
item.description: South Korean police identified seven suspects in a cybercrime operation that breached more than 90 organizations, mostly using the ARTEX AI pentesting framework. Authorities believe 8.2 million records were stolen, and the gang leader has a penetration-testing background. Why it matters: Shows how an AI pentesting framework was used in breaches of more than 90 organizations in South Korea.

item.title: In-the-Wild Attack Abuses AI Agents' Trust in Markdown
item.description: Forever Security reports a real-world prompt injection where a malicious markdown file in a downloads folder can make a coding agent install malware and steal credentials.

item.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra with 3x faster AI agents, 50% lower pricing
item.description: OpenAI launched GPT-6.1 Terra, a faster, cheaper model for computer use, visual reasoning and coding, at $1 and $5 per million input and output tokens.

item.title: Anthropic's IPO outlines an unusual succession plan: confidential, ranked lists of up to 10 successors per co-founder, subject to approval from five co-founders
item.description: Anthropic's IPO filing includes confidential, ranked lists of up to 10 successors for each co-founder's voting power, subject to approval from five co-founders.

item.title: Anthropic Files for Potentially the Biggest IPO Ever as CEO Warns of Risk to Humanity From AI
item.description: Anthropic filed papers for what could be the biggest IPO ever, as its CEO warns advanced AI could pose an existential threat to humanity.

item.title: Proton To ‘Re-Interview’ Staff About AI To See Who Gets To Keep Their Job
item.description: Proton told staff it will 're-interview' employees about how they use AI, which may affect continued employment, a leaked email says.

item.title: Some Observations About Anthropic’s IPO Filing
item.description: Anthropic's 335-page S-1 reports first-half 2026 revenue of $16.3 billion, up 14x from a year earlier, alongside an $80 billion net loss.

item.title: Prediction market traders say an Anthropic IPO is near-certain this year after company filed with SEC
item.description: Anthropic filed its Form S-1 with the SEC on Monday; Kalshi traders put 95% odds on an official IPO announcement by end of 2026.

item.title: US judge says firing of daughter of former FBI director unlawful
item.description: A US judge ruled that the Justice Department unlawfully fired Maurene Comey, daughter of former FBI director James Comey, and ordered her retroactively reinstated.

item.title: Sources: Hong Kong-based stablecoin payments startup RedotPay plans a US IPO filing by year-end and is in talks for a pre-IPO round at a $4B to $5B valuation
item.description: Hong Kong stablecoin payments startup RedotPay reportedly plans a US IPO filing by year-end and is in pre-IPO talks at a $4-5 billion valuation.

item.title: Apple adds more Siri AI tools in its 27.2 system updates, out today
item.description: Apple has rolled out software updates across all its platforms, including new Siri AI tools in its 27.2 system updates.

item.title: CZ pitches BNB Chain’s role in AI as BNB Standard rings Nasdaq bell
item.description: CZ sees AI driving crypto use, while BNB Standard, which rang the Nasdaq bell, plans to expand beyond holding tokens in its treasury.

item.title: How to teach with Databricks Free Edition
item.description: Databricks Free Edition is a perpetually free version of its platform that lets students work in the browser with no cloud contract, license, or installation.

item.title: DoorDash Nears Deal to Buy Instacart in $17 Billion Deal
item.description: According to sources, DoorDash is in advanced talks to buy Instacart for around $17 billion; a deal could come within days.

item.title: Apple announces Siri AI will expand to these new languages soon
item.description: Apple's iOS 27.2 added new Siri AI features and five new languages, and announced four more languages coming soon.

item.title: Apple debuts iOS 27.2, with Siri AI enhancements for recalling past conversations, understanding more personal context, supporting five more languages, and more
item.description: Apple released iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2, letting Siri AI recall past conversations and adding five languages.

item.title: Swarmatory: Shared chatroom/feed for your team's coding agents
item.description: Swarmatory is a self-hosted shared feed where a team's coding agents post, reply and coordinate overlapping work, with humans able to read along.

item.title: AI, Scripts, Operator: Inside the ConnectWise Attack
item.description: Microsoft says an AI agent drove the ConnectWise attack using the open-source ARTEX framework; Huntress telemetry aligns but does not independently confirm.

item.title: Fusion startups are giving the government shares in exchange for awards. Is it worth it?
item.description: Helion and Commonwealth Fusion Systems received $260 million in Commerce Department CHIPS Act awards and gave the government nonvoting shares in return.

item.title: Apple releases iOS and macOS 27.2 with new Siri AI features, new Music logo
item.description: Apple released iOS and macOS 27.2 with enhanced Siri AI features, a new Music logo, and limits on which apps Siri can access.

item.title: AI company Anthropic announces IPO, expected as early as November
item.description: Anthropic has filed for an IPO on Nasdaq, disclosing over $16 billion in first-half 2026 revenue and an $80 billion net loss.

item.title: AI stocks rise as Anthropic nears Wall Street debut amid investor caution
item.description: Anthropic is nearing a Wall Street debut, and analysts say its successful flotation could reshape how markets value parts of the booming AI industry.

item.title: US designates helium as a critical material
Building live intelligence: Databricks AI Search supports Streaming Tables, Materialized Views, and Managed tables using Iceberg
item.description: Databricks AI Search now supports Streaming Tables, Materialized Views, and Managed Iceberg v3+ tables, so live data can feed search without separate pipelines.

item.title: What Anthropic left out of their draft S-1
item.description: Gregory (Scotland Yard detective): Is there any other point to which you would wish to draw my attention? Sherlock Holmes: To the curious incident of the dog in the night-time.

item.title: Fleet-wide computer vision lifecycle at the edge with SageMaker SDK v3
item.description: A SageMaker SDK v3 reference architecture trains, quality-gates, and compiles per-camera vision models with SageMaker Neo, versioning thousands of them.

item.title: Y Combinator-backed Mochatrade raises $5.5 million to offer US stock perpetuals to Indian traders
item.description: Y Combinator-backed Mochatrade raised $5.5 million to offer US stock perpetuals to Indian traders; its platform is in beta.

item.title: This startup’s self-driving excavators help dig up $600M in new funding
item.description: Bedrock Robotics raised $600 million at a $4.1 billion valuation; its self-driving kit can be retrofitted onto construction and other worksite vehicles.

item.title: In Leaked Audio, Flock CEO Tells Cops Backlash to the Company Isn’t Real
item.description: In leaked audio, Flock CEO Garrett Langley told police chiefs anti-Flock protests aren't real, claiming without evidence that Russian bots drive online opposition.

item.title: Groundhog Day for AI agents: Prompt caching patterns for using OpenAI models on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: Prompt caching for OpenAI models on Amazon Bedrock lets agents reuse repeated context such as tools, instructions, and history, cutting input cost and latency.

item.title: Microsoft to offer buyouts to 60,000 workers in latest cost cut
item.description: Microsoft is offering buyouts to 60,000 workers in its latest cost cut, after shedding tens of thousands of workers in recent years.

item.title: We tried to automate Epoch
item.description: Epoch's Automation Reports test AI on real work tasks its staff do regularly, such as graphic design; top models complete about two-thirds of the rubric.

item.title: OpenHands Software Agent SDK before 1.52.0 contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability…
item.description: OpenHands Software Agent SDK before 1.52.0 allows unauthenticated remote code execution because its sandbox servers bind to all interfaces with authentication off by default.

item.title: Anthropic discloses month-long training pause, AI security breaches in IPO filing
item.description: Anthropic's IPO filing shows it paused training of its next flagship model for over a month over security concerns.

item.title: How NVIDIA Minerva Turns Telemetry Chaos Into Peak GPU Yield
item.description: NVIDIA's Minerva addresses telemetry split across AI factory teams, where subtle GPU, storage, and network faults can slow distributed training.

item.title: Microsoft offers buyouts to around 60,000 employees to contain costs
item.description: Microsoft is offering voluntary buyouts to about 60,000 employees, more than a quarter of its global workforce, as it looks to contain costs and fund its AI investments. The offers cover the US, UK, Canada and India. Why it matters: Shows how major tech firms are reshaping staff to fund AI spending, relevant to AI and markets readers.

item.title: OCC calls on community banks to enter the stablecoin payments market
item.description: The OCC urged community banks to seek permission to issue dollar-pegged stablecoins under the GENIUS Act, whose finalized rules require compliance by Jan. 18, 2027.

item.title: Story that spotlights trash generated by blind boxes bags ST gold and silver at Asian Media Awards
item.description: A Straits Times story on trash from blind boxes won gold and silver at the Asian Media Awards.

item.title: How NVIDIA Mission Control 2.5 Brings Autonomous Recovery to Kubernetes
item.description: NVIDIA's Mission Control autonomous recovery engine, which detects, diagnoses, and recovers from anomalies across the stack, now extends to Kubernetes.

item.title: Apple reveals updated iPad mini with a bigger OLED screen for $700
item.description: Apple unveiled a revamped iPad mini with an OLED display, water-resistant design, faster chip, priced at US$699.
